description.value: Renaissance Coffee has been a fixture of Simon Fraser University's Burnaby Mountain campus for over 20 years, run by Parminder and his team from the AQ 3000 level of the Academic Quadrangle. It serves Fair Trade espresso beverages, brewed coffee, wholesome meals, and desserts to the SFU community. The venue is takeout-only with no outdoor seating, making it a quick-stop option for cyclists passing through the SFU campus on weekdays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active SFU campus cafe operated for 20+ years, featuring Fair Trade espresso, meals, and desserts at AQ 3000 level; OSM tags takeaway=only and internet_access=no align with the website's takeout-focused description and absence of any Wi-Fi mention. Phone number 778-782-4456 matches between OSM and website, and address details are consistent. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, or washrooms was found in either source; the venue is closed weekends and holidays per the website, which conflicts slightly with OSM hours but is consistent in showing weekday-only operation.
concerns: Closed weekends and holidays per website — most touring cyclists travel on weekends, making this venue rarely accessible to them
Takeout-only, no outdoor seating (OSM outdoor_seating=no; website describes no sit-down option)
Minor address discrepancy: OSM uses 'University Drive East' while website uses 'University Drive'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate and long-established food venue, but closed on weekends and holidays and takeout-only with no seating — conditions that substantially limit its utility for touring cyclists who most commonly travel on weekends.

wow_evidence: closed on weekends and holidays and takeout-only with no outdoor seating
